title: Legal & Admin Executive
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

**Legal \& Compliance Responsibilities:**

* Draft, review, and finalize property\-related agreements, including Agreements for Sale, Sale/Conveyance Deeds, Development Agreements, Joint Venture (JV) Agreements, and Lease Deeds.
* Prepare Power of Attorney (POA), MOUs, indemnities, affidavits, and tenant surrender documents.
* Coordinate stamping, execution, and registration of property documents with relevant authorities
* Liaise with government and municipal bodies (such as Land Revenue offices, BL\&LRO, local municipal corporations, and registration offices) for statutory clearances and assessments.
* Ensure compliance with local real estate laws, RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority) guidelines, and corporate policies.
* Coordinate and manage civil, criminal, or consumer disputes/litigation involving company properties alongside external counsels and panel advocates.
* Maintain a structured tracking system (MIS) for all ongoing court cases, property files, and land acquisition statuses.
* Coordinate land and registry office searches Conduct preliminary and detailed legal and title due diligence for proposed land and property acquisitions.
* Examine historical title chains, ownership history, and identify potential title defects, encumbrances, claims, or mortgages.
* Verify revenue and land records (e.g., Khatian, Dag/Plot numbers, Mouza, mutation, and conversion records). to confirm clean ownership.
* Visit High Court / Lower Divisional Court / Land \& Land Reforms Offices or other authorities for official submissions or follow\-up work when required.
* Maintain case files, hearing schedules, and compliance trackers.
* Support land\-related documentation work — mutation, conversion, and due diligence papers.
* Ensure timely renewals and filings of company licenses, property\-related documents, and legal registers.
* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure legal and administrative compliance in all operations.

**Administrative Responsibilities:**

* Manage office facilities, housekeeping, logistics, stationery, and daily administrative operations.
* Handle correspondence, record keeping, courier dispatch, and filing (both electronic and physical).
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and site teams for administrative and operational requirements.
* Maintain and renew trade licenses, property tax, professional tax, and other statutory registrations.
* Assist in HR\-related tasks such as attendance, leave records, and staff coordination when required.
* Manage meeting schedules, travel arrangements, and minutes of meetings.
* Support management in preparing reports, notices, and internal communications.

Candidate Requirements:

* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) from a recognized university; active enrollment with the State Bar Council is frequently preferred / Diploma in Administration, Management
* 3 to 7\+ years of hands\-on legal experience working with a real estate developer, property investment firm, or corporate law firm handling property law and administrative work.
* Strong drafting and analytical capabilities.
* Sound knowledge of property laws, local land revenue procedures, and registration formalities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bengali.
* Sound knowledge of MS Office, Excel, Google Sheets, and Google Workspace, ChatGPT \& AI tools
* Strong letter drafting and follow\-up skills with corporates and government departments.
* Flexibility to travel within Kolkata for official purposes.
* Driving a two\-wheeler (Scooty) preferred, though not mandatory.
* Should be detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and capable of handling multiple responsibilities independently.
* Salary ₹24,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month
* Should stay at a distance of 45 minutes to 1 hour from salt lake sector V

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹24,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Application Question(s):

* How many years of legal experience do you have?
* Are you an immediate joiner?
* do you stay 45 minutes to 1 hour from salt lake sector V

Work Location: In person

title: Legal Analyst [U.S Process]
description:
Great media Technologies is hiring a detail\-oriented Legal Analyst to support the research, drafting, and case\-management work of a U.S. law firm.

This position is suited to a law graduate who can analyse complex documents, write clear professional English, manage competing deadlines, and take responsibility for assignments without repeated reminders. The work will involve substantive legal support, not merely data entry or document formatting.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Legal research and analysis: Research relevant U.S. statutes, court rules, and case law. Prepare concise memoranda that distinguish established facts, legal conclusions, uncertainties, and recommended next steps. Verify every authority cited.
* Drafting and document review: Prepare first drafts of pleadings, declarations, discovery requests and responses, correspondence, and other case documents under attorney supervision. Check factual consistency, citations, formatting, and exhibit references.
* Case\-file preparation: Review records, correspondence, contracts, and financial documents. Build chronologies, evidence summaries, exhibit indexes, and lists of missing information or inconsistencies.
* Deadline and workflow management: Maintain accurate case trackers and task lists. Record the source and assumptions behind proposed deadlines, obtain attorney confirmation, and escalate missing instructions or deadline risks promptly.
* Professional communication: Draft clear client updates and attorney correspondence. Coordinate document collection, appointments, and follow\-ups within the authority assigned to the role.
* Quality, confidentiality, and accountability: Maintain organised files, version control, and accurate time records. Use only approved systems and AI tools, independently verify their output, and protect confidential information.

**Required qualifications:**

* Applicants must have at least two years of substantive legal work after completing their qualifying law degree. Student internships do not count toward this minimum.
* Excellent written and spoken English, supported by strong legal drafting and research skills.
* Experience handling legal documents and managing multiple assignments with attention to accuracy and deadlines.
* Proficiency in word processing, tracked changes, PDF review, spreadsheets, and organised electronic case files.
* Sound judgment, receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to identify and escalate issues rather than conceal uncertainty.
* Availability to work from the Kolkata office during the stated U.S.\-aligned shift.

**Preferred experience:**

* Prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm or legal process outsourcing team is an advantage. Particularly relevant experience includes civil or family litigation, discovery, document review, case chronologies, and professional client correspondence.
* Familiarity with U.S. legal research platforms and case\-management systems is desirable. Candidates with strong Indian litigation or research experience may also be considered, subject to assessment.

Pay: ₹27,000\.00 \- ₹34,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
